stem: Which situation does this cartoon from an early 1900s pamphlet illustrate?

options.label: A
options.text: The deportation of many Chinese immigrants in the Northwest

options.label: B
options.text: The recruitment of Chinese immigrants by large labor unions in the Midwest

options.label: C
options.text: The fear in the West of losing jobs to Chinese immigrants

options.label: D
